location.location_note: IREN's official page identifies Sweetwater, TX but not a county; DCD and KTXS place the Sweetwater 1 and 2 sites outside Sweetwater in Fisher County. Baseline/Cleanview/interconnection trackers list Nolan County, so county remains a tracked contradiction.

status_as_of_cutoff: partial live: IREN announced Sweetwater 1 1.4GW high-voltage substation energization on 2026-05-01, with power delivery expected to ramp as data centers are constructed and commissioned; IREN's current Sweetwater page lists the 2,000 MW campus and both Sweetwater 1 and 2 as under construction.
evidence_grade: company-official for capacity/status; local-media/industry for county placement; no current county permit/order record found in indexed public sources

actions.action_type: public-company regulatory filing reporting utility/interconnection status
actions.result_or_status: IREN's filing reports Sweetwater 1 (1,400 MW) and Sweetwater 2 (600 MW) under development, with paid connection deposits and executed ERCOT-grid connection agreements.
actions.access_caveat: SEC filing is a company disclosure filed with a regulator, not an ERCOT or county approval order; it does not publish the underlying interconnection agreements.
actions.notes: ERCOT/utility status evidence; no vote inferred.

actions.result_or_status: IREN announced successful energization of its 1.4GW Sweetwater 1 data center site in Texas; the high-voltage substation was connected to the ERCOT grid and power delivery is expected to ramp with phased data-center construction and commissioning.
actions.case_or_number: IREN news release: Successful Energization of Sweetwater 1
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; confirms substation/grid energization, not full data-center buildout or county permit approval.
actions.notes: Status promoted from site work/construction to partial live for the energized Sweetwater 1 grid/substation phase.

actions.result_or_status: IREN's Sweetwater page lists a 2,000 MW, 2,200-acre West Texas AI campus across Sweetwater 1 (1,400 MW, 1,700 acres, 2026 substation energization, under construction) and Sweetwater 2 (600 MW, 500 acres, 2027 substation energization, under construction).
actions.access_caveat: Company-maintained project page; page identifies Sweetwater, TX, USA and West Texas but does not name the county.
actions.notes: Capacity, acreage, owner/operator, and construction status evidence.

contradictions.details: Baseline, Cleanview, Interconnection.fyi, and some image/industry references list Nolan County; DCD and KTXS local reporting place the Sweetwater sites outside Sweetwater in Fisher County. IREN's official page does not specify county.

Cleanview and Interconnection.fyi still show Sweetwater 1 as planned/proposed, while IREN announced Sweetwater 1 substation energization on 2026-05-01 and IREN's current page labels Sweetwater 1 and 2 under construction.
